setting: You both live in Nairobi, Kenya, and have been together for about a year, having met through mutual friends at a birthday dinner in Westlands. You have met each other's families, and you know each other's work schedules, habits and the places you each like to eat. This is the first trip you have planned together, so you are still working out the budget and which parts of the country to see.
opener: Sends Brian a message asking whether he would rather see Diani or Lamu first, with two flight options attached.

Wanjiru.who: 29, woman, the partner planning the trip
Wanjiru.knows: You know Brian is your boyfriend of about a year, and that he is a site engineer who is often away from the office and busy with deadlines. You know he grew up in Eldoret, that he is careful with money, and that he has wanted to see the coast for years.
Wanjiru.like: You are organised and curious, and you like making a plan and seeing it through, though you are relaxed about the details once things are settled.
Wanjiru.texts: You message in this chat now and then, mostly when there is something to decide or book, and otherwise you leave the conversation to Brian.
Wanjiru.style: You type with normal capitals and punctuation, use a full stop at the end of most sentences, and rarely use emoji.

Brian.who: 31, man, the partner who is going along with the trip plan
Brian.knows: You know Wanjiru is your girlfriend of about a year, and that she is a pharmacist who likes to plan everything in advance. You know she loves the idea of the coast, and that she is still getting used to how quickly you can change your mind about plans.
Brian.like: You are easygoing and practical, and you tend to go with the flow until something needs a firm answer.
Brian.texts: You message in this chat now and then, usually to answer questions or confirm things, and you rarely start a conversation yourself.
Brian.style: You type in lowercase with little punctuation, use short messages, and occasionally send a single emoji.

private_lines.Wanjiru: You live in a one-bedroom flat in Kilimani with a flatmate, Achieng, a nurse who works night shifts. You work as a pharmacist at a clinic in Lavington, leaving home around seven and usually back by six. Evenings are mostly cooking, a bit of television, and checking messages before bed.
private_lines.Brian: You live alone in a studio flat in Kileleshwa and work as a site engineer on road projects, which means early starts and some weeks spent away from the city. When you are in Nairobi you finish work around five, go to the gym or meet friends for a drink, and usually head home to cook something simple.

situation: A couple planning their first trip together.

text:
diani or lamu first?
[attached: flight option 1, flight option 2]
first one is 06:50 out of JKIA. second is 14:20, about 3k cheaper each way
at the bar with the boys, will look properly later
diani first i think. lamu means a long boat ride and i dont want to be on boats the whole trip
but the flight is your call, you know the timing better
diani first then. 14:20 means we land mombasa late. is that ok for transfer?
transfer is fine, we book a shuttle. but 14:20 gets us to ukunda late, is the 3k still worth it after the shuttle?
ask me tomorrow, about to sleep
ok. will price the shuttle tmrw
shuttle from ukunda is 4,500 each way from the airport. for 14:20 that means we pay both legs
or we take the 06:50 and i'm up at 4 for it lol
sorry was on site all morning. no signal near the culvert
06:50 is brutal but 3k each way is 6k saved. shuttle is 9k total for the late one so the saving disappears
so its the early flight
ok. booking the 06:50 then
we'll need to be at jkia by 05:00 so i'll ask achieng if she can drop us, she's on nights that week
that's sorted then. i'll get off early on friday
or not early, i'll be done when i'm done. but i'll try
ok
achieng says she can do it but not the week after, we should go before then or we need a taxi
which week is she on nights
the week of the 30th?
yeah. so the 30th is fine
will book the room in ukunda for the 30th then
ok
booked the 06:50. confirmed on the app
need your name exactly as on your ID, middle name too
sorry, phone was in the truck. its on the id, brian kiprop mutai
ok adding it
ukunda room. the one with the pool is 14k a night, other one is 9k and no pool
pool one. but that's 6 nights
we dont need to spend it all on the room
we're not going to the coast to sit in a room lol
pump at the culvert died again. foreman wants it fixed by thurs or we lose the week
might be late friday
ok. are you still coming friday night or saturday morning
friday night if the pump works. saturday 4am if not 😂
no
you're not getting me up at 4 twice
ok the pool room. i'll cook less and we eat out one night
one night. that's the deal
deal
achieng says she can do the drop-off on the 30th but she's swapping shifts so she might be half asleep
i'll buy her a samosa
